scope: NARROW. Closes four contract-level defects in V1 and one schema inconsistency. Changes no frozen biological constraint and targets no retention fraction.
CENTRAL_RULE_FROZEN_HERE: The admissible control set is ALL integer hg19 starts on the pre-drawn side satisfying distance matching and promoter-specific exclusion, that then pass exact C3 round trip, hg38 Nott PU.1 overlap, and NIH-CARD consensus support. Any proposal-space shortcut must be demonstrably lossless relative to that set.

B1_CONTROL_B_MUST_NOT_RESCUE_CONTROL_A.defect_in_V1: V1 said 'if only one of the two passes the hg38 gate, the edge retains that one'. That lets CONTROL_B stand in for a failed CONTROL_A, which changes what the primary population is.

frozen_rule.A_fails: the linked edge DROPS from the primary population, regardless of whether B succeeded. B may never substitute for A.
frozen_rule.A_succeeds_and_B_fails: the edge REMAINS in the primary and is flagged control_b_available = false, making it unavailable for the control-vs-control null only.
frozen_rule.A_succeeds_and_B_succeeds: the edge is in the primary and is available for the null.

B1_CONTROL_B_MUST_NOT_RESCUE_CONTROL_A.reporting: primary population size and control-vs-control null population size are reported separately; the null population is smaller by construction and that must be visible, not implied.

defect_in_V1_and_in_my_own_attempted_rep.what_I_then_drafted: I was about to strengthen that to 'CONTROL_B must be DISJOINT from CONTROL_A', reasoning that near-duplicates would make the control-vs-control null artificially tight.
defect_in_V1_and_in_my_own_attempted_rep.why_BOTH_are_wrong: Any rule that constrains B given A conditions the second draw on the first and changes its distribution. The control-vs-control null is only a valid null if A and B are INDEPENDENT draws from the same admissible distribution. Forcing them apart makes them anti-correlated, which mis-specifies the null just as surely as allowing duplicates would -- and my 'fix' conditioned B on A more strongly than the rule it replaced.
defect_in_V1_and_in_my_own_attempted_rep.status: my disjointness draft is WITHDRAWN and was never committed

frozen_rule.independence: CONTROL_A and CONTROL_B are drawn INDEPENDENTLY, each with its own side draw from a distinct frozen sub-seed, from the identical admissible distribution.
frozen_rule.if_they_coincide: RECORD IT. Do not redraw. A coincidence is a legitimate outcome of two independent draws and its frequency is itself informative about how small some admissible sets are.
frozen_rule.recorded_field: control_a_equals_control_b (boolean), plus the count across the population

B3_PROPOSAL_PREFILTER_REMOVED.defect_in_V1: V1's candidate universe included K, a prefilter requiring the hg19 window to overlap a reverse-lifted hg19 PU.1 peak. The authoritative requirement is hg38 PU.1 overlap AFTER exact C3 lifting. A matching peak count (50,199 in both) does not prove the reverse-lifted track is lossless for INTERVAL OVERLAP, because chain offsets can change overlap relationships near block boundaries.

what_I_measured.test: 16,899 windows that FAIL the hg19 prefilter, lifted and tested against the authoritative hg38 gate
what_I_measured.status: SUPPORTIVE EVIDENCE ONLY, NOT A PROOF. It is a one-directional sample on one chain and does not establish losslessness. It is recorded because it was measured, not because it justifies keeping K.

B3_PROPOSAL_PREFILTER_REMOVED.frozen_resolution: K IS REMOVED. There is no proposal-space biological filter at all.

replacement.admissible_hg19_set: A_S = the integer starts on the pre-drawn side S whose 5 kb window midpoint lies at signed distance within [d0 - tol, d0 + tol], MINUS starts whose window overlaps an E2 distal partner of THIS promoter. Exact, contiguous-interval arithmetic, no lattice.
replacement.sampling: draw uniformly at random, WITH replacement, from the integers of A_S
replacement.why_512_suffices: A uniform 5 kb window overlaps at least one of the 50,199 PU.1 peaks (26.3 Mb total span) with probability about 0.0895 genome-wide, so the chance of missing an existing survivor in 512 independent uniform draws is about 1.4e-21. The budget is set from that arithmetic, computed before execution, not from any observed retention.
every_constraint_applied_in_hg38: single forward mapping, ambiguity detected and rejected
exact hg38->hg19 round trip, tolerance 0 bp
replacement.drop_reason_semantics: an edge with no surviving control after the full budget is recorded as CONTROL_NOT_FOUND_WITHIN_FROZEN_DRAW_BUDGET. That is an honest sampling-limited statement and must never be reported as 'no admissible control exists'.

B4_STOP_CONDITION_REMOVED.defect_in_V1: V1 listed 'the exact interval sampler produces an empty universe for a majority of edges, which would indicate the universe definition itself is wrong' as a STOP condition.
B4_STOP_CONDITION_REMOVED.why_that_is_wrong: A surprisingly low control-support rate may simply be the real answer. Treating a low number as evidence that the design is broken licenses redesigning until retention looks acceptable, which is the precise failure the no-retention-target rule exists to prevent.
B4_STOP_CONDITION_REMOVED.frozen_resolution: REMOVED. A low control-support rate is a RESULT and is reported as one.
retained_stop_conditions: linked/control attrition fails to reconcile to 20,709
a forbidden biological correspondence is materialised

B5_SCHEMA_CONSISTENCY.defect_in_V1: V1 introduced CONTROL_A and CONTROL_B as population labels, silently widening the enum frozen by V64_NIH_CARD_STAGE3_FEATURE_ARTIFACT_CONTRACT_V1, which fixes population as LINKED | CONTROL.

frozen_resolution.population: LINKED | CONTROL, unchanged from the Stage-3 feature artifact contract
frozen_resolution.control_role: A | B, a separate column, empty for LINKED rows
frozen_resolution.rationale: adds the distinction without redefining a frozen enum

UNCHANGED_FROM_V1.A2_C3_exact_round_trip: full forward + ambiguity detection + exact reverse lift, tolerance 0 bp
UNCHANGED_FROM_V1.A3_side_drawn_first: side drawn with the frozen seed before admissibility is consulted; an empty drawn side drops the edge and is NOT retried on the other side
UNCHANGED_FROM_V1.A5_anchor_frequency: number of DISTINCT E2 promoters whose distal partners OVERLAP the interval
UNCHANGED_FROM_V1.A7_receipt_provenance: producer git blob and sha256, emitted artifact SHA-256s, authenticated byte receipt, pairing closeout, E2 digest, and this contract's sha256
frozen_biological_constraints: identical support rules for linked and control

VERIFIED_BY_BRUTE_FORCE_BEFORE_FREEZING.distance_band_formula: the contiguous-interval form of the signed distance band matched exhaustive enumeration on 200 random cases
VERIFIED_BY_BRUTE_FORCE_BEFORE_FREEZING.window_overlap_formula: the [start-4999, end-1] start-interval form of '5 kb window overlaps interval' matched exhaustive enumeration

governance.phase_B_matrix_reads: REMAIN STOPPED until the repaired Phase A is re-audited
